Frequently Asked Questions

What guides are available on this page?

This guide hub contains every major guide for It Reaches, including the Complete Walkthrough, Puzzle Guide, Endings Guide, Monster Guide, Story & Lore, and Achievement Guide.

Where should I start as a new player?

Start with the Beginner Guide to learn the body camera perspective and survival basics, then move to the Complete Walkthrough for chapter-by-chapter progression.

Are all endings covered?

The Endings Guide covers a speculative framework for the likely ending types. Exact names and unlock conditions are being verified against the full release.

How many achievements are tracked?

The Achievement Guide tracks all 20 Steam achievements, including missable warnings and unlock conditions.
